I am extremely disappointed with my recent experience with Myntra. At the time of placing the order of athena sequined skirt… there was no clear mention of any ₹50 return fee. The only information provided was that ₹23 would be deducted as a platform fee in case of a return. However, when I actually returned the skirt, an additional ₹50 was deducted under the name of “return fee.” My concern is not simply about the amount, but about the lack of transparency. If a return fee is applicable, it should be clearly disclosed to the customer before the order is placed, not introduced at the time of return. What made the experience even worse was the customer service. Instead of addressing my concern properly, the representative behaved in a highly unprofessional manner and disconnected the call in the middle of the conversation. This is completely unacceptable for a platform of Myntra’s stature. Customers deserve clear policies, transparent charges, and respectful customer service. Unexpected deductions and such poor handling of genuine complaints seriously damage customer trust. After this experience, I have decided that I will no longer purchase anything from Myntra, nor will I recommend Myntra to anyone. A company may consider ₹50 insignificant, but for a customer, transparency and trust are far more valuable than ₹50. Extremely disappointing and unacceptable experience.
